step1.title: Meet Your Reading Timer!
step1.description: This floating timer tracks your reading time and gives you control over your session. Let's explore what each button does!

step2.description: Click the center button to start or pause your reading timer. The timer only counts when you're actively reading!

step3.title: Add More Time
step3.description: Need more reading time? Click the green + button to add extra minutes to your session!

step4.title: Add More Pages
step4.description: Want to continue the adventure? Click this button to add 5 more pages to your story!

step5.title: Adjust Difficulty
step5.description: Too easy or too hard? Use these arrow buttons to make the text easier or more challenging for your reading level!

step6.title: Navigation & Controls
step6.description: Use 'New Story' to create a different adventure, or 'Home' to return to the main page. Previous/Next buttons move between story pages!
